props.name: glyphs
props.description: Glyphs to fall. Katakana by default, because that is the look.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size in pixels. Column width follows it.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour for the trailing glyphs.

props.name: headColor
props.description: The leading glyph of each column, brighter than the tail.

props.name: trail
props.description: How long a tail persists, 0 to 1. Higher is longer.
